notes:
• PF2e and SF2e: a skill in the readout shows its modifier, training, attribute and the sheet's breakdown of every bonus in it, a button for each of the system's actions that use it (Balance, Tumble Through, Grapple and the rest, one for each way of doing those with several), which takes the action through the system, and those actions' rules text.
  • D&D 5e: skills, tools and an item's activities can be marked as favorites from the readout, as on the sheet, as items and effects already could.
  • A blank item of any kind the system has, from a New item picker beside the Inventory tab's quick search: made, named as Foundry names a new one, and opened on its sheet to fill in.
  • Delete in a thing's right-click editor, behind Foundry's own are-you-sure.
